Add a Chart object to a workbook sheet

Source: R/utils.R
wb_add_encharter.Rd

Renders a Chart R6 object and injects the resulting XML into an openxlsx2 workbook at the specified location.

wb_add_encharter(wb, sheet = openxlsx2::current_sheet(), dims = NULL, graph)

Arguments

wb

An openxlsx2 workbook object.

sheet

Sheet name or index where the chart will be placed.

dims

Character string defining the cell range (e.g., "E2:M20").

graph

An initialized Chart R6 object.

Value

The workbook object, invisibly.
